data.name: Operator Traits
data.teaser: Bring Project Zomboid–style character building to SPT with positive and negative traits based on EFT’s current season, making every profile play differently.
data.description:
Operator Traits

Operator Traits is a character-building mod for SPT that lets you shape your PMC with a mix of positive and negative traits.

Choose useful benefits such as improved stamina, slower energy consumption, quieter movement, and stronger bones. Balance them with negative traits that make survival more difficult, including allergies, faster hydration loss, restricted secure-container access, or losing access to the Flea Market.

Traits are selected from a native Traits tab added directly to Tarkov’s character menu. Your choices are saved per profile and remain active until you pay 50 GP coins to reset them.

Operator Traits is designed to avoid permanent profile changes. If the mod is removed, its traits and gameplay effects will stop applying, and your profile should return to standard SPT behavior. As a precaution, you can backup your profile

How It Works

Positive traits cost points, while negative traits grant points. Take enough negative traits to cover the positive traits you want.

Once confirmed, your traits are locked to the profile. Resetting costs 50 GP coins and clears all selected traits and generated allergies.

Positive Traits

  • Street Tax — Receive a weekly protection payment from local Scavs
  • Diet — Food and drinks consume 50% less resource
  • Juice Time — Drinking juice grants Painkiller for 60 seconds
  • Hypodipsia — Hydration drains 20% slower
  • Sailor’s Nostalgia — Canned fish grants temporary health regeneration
  • Sprinter — Sprint 5% faster
  • Polyphagia — Energy drains 20% slower
  • Thrombophilia — Bleeding chance is reduced by 25%
  • Marathon Runner — Arm and leg stamina drain 20% slower
  • Youth — Gain additional stamina and slower energy drain
  • Sturdy Bones — Reduce fracture chance and falling damage
  • Bush Borne — Vegetation causes less noise and slowdown
  • Safecracker — Mechanical keys have a chance to lose no durability

Negative Traits

  • Chronic Fatigue Syndrome — Energy drains 15% faster
  • Third Leg — Move slightly slower in exchange for cheaper Therapist prices
  • Polydipsia — Hydration drains 20% faster
  • Dr. Jekyll — Fresh Wounds cannot be removed until the raid ends
  • Hemophilia — Bleeding chance is increased by 25%
  • Well That Hurt! — Medkits consume 25% more resources
  • Allergic — Three random provisions or medications become allergens
  • Osteoporosis — Fracture chance and falling damage are increased
  • Broken Secure Container — Restricts which items can enter your secure container
  • Exhaustion — Reduces stamina capacity and recovery
  • No Flea Market — Disables player-to-player Flea Market trading

More traits coming soon

  • This is just the start and foundation, i plan to add way more traits in following updates that arent just copies of the current season

What’s missing

  • Some seasonal EFT traits are intentionally excluded because they permanently modify profile data and cannot be safely removed through a normal trait reset.

[Warning] Allergies!!!

Taking Allergic assigns three random food, drink, or medication items as allergens for your profile. Using one during a raid triggers a temporary reaction using Tarkov’s native intoxication, tremor, and tunnel-vision effects. This wont kill you but it will force you to use healing items

Your allergens remain persistent until the trait is removed or your traits are reset.
data.custom_ai_disclosure: AI was used as a development aid to inspect decompiled DLLs, identify relevant classes and methods, and assist with portions of the GUI and configuration system. Every feature was individually coded/designed, reviewed, and manually tested in-game to ensure it worked as intended and to the performance standards i hold myself to.
